A FEW HELPFUL DETAILS

Before we
begin.

Can you help if I’m outside Kenya?+

Yes. Our services are designed to support Kenyans abroad, international guests, and owners managing interests remotely. Tell us where you need local support and we’ll confirm the arrangements.

Can I combine several services?+

Absolutely. You can combine airport reception, transport, lifestyle requests, relocation support, or other services into one agreed brief.

How do you price your services?+

Services are quoted around your request, location, timing, and the coordination required. Contact us with a few details and we will confirm the service scope and applicable third-party costs before proceeding.

What is the easiest way to reach you?+

Message us on WhatsApp, call +254 717 762323, or email info.kenyatravelconcierge@gmail.com. Our enquiry page helps you put your request together.
